expected_symptom: dxc fails internally (assert / access violation / fatal error) compiling a shader whose [numthreads] argument is a static const uint; a well-formed diagnostic is not the symptom
history: never-repro'd-in-releases -- NOT a fix: all 20 release binaries are Release builds with asserts compiled out (NDEBUG), so they cannot show this symptom; still asserts on Debug main (eff900d54)
summary: Assert still fires on Debug main (eff900d54): assert(MaybeODRUseExprs.empty() && 'Leftover expressions for odr-use checking'), SemaDecl.cpp:11156 in Sema::ActOnFinishFunctionBody, exit 0xE0000001. Not [numthreads]-specific -- [maxvertexcount] with an identifier argument asserts identically; both route through ValidateAttributeIntArg. Needs an empty function body: referencing the constant in the body suppresses it (workaround). All 20 releases v1.4.1907..v1.9.2607 compile it cleanly with the right thread-group size (!{i32 8, i32 8, i32 1}) -- because asserts are compiled out of Release builds, NOT because it was fixed.
title: Assert when a static const uint is used with [numthreads]
